name: canchaya-e2e
description: Pruebas de extremo a extremo (E2E) con Playwright para CanchaYA

scripts.db:seed:test: cd canchaya-backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=test_e2e npx ts-node src/seed-test-db.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:init && npm run db:seed:test && cross-env NODE_ENV=test_e2e playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run db:init && npm run db:seed:test && cross-env NODE_ENV=test_e2e playwright test --ui
